title: 初请近60年低位：裁员信号却缺席，19.4万背后谁在撑住招聘？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Yeah, so jobless claims come in at just over 194,000 and that's more or less in line with expectations and maybe touch below it Lisa but you know just speaks to the idea that the labor market is still
segments.zh: 是的，失业救济申请人数略高于19.4万，与预期基本一致，可能略低于预期，Lisa，但这说明劳动力市场仍然普遍稳定。

segments.en: broadly stable. These jobless claims remain around decades low. We're not seeing any broad-based signs of layoffs and these numbers as I say maybe touch the downside here hinting at some
segments.zh: 这些失业救济申请人数仍处于数十年低位。我们没有看到任何广泛的裁员迹象，这些数字可能略低于预期，暗示劳动力市场存在一些自持的领域，但未必会引发警报。

segments.en: self-reliant pockets of labor market but not necessarily setting off alarm bells. It does build into a week of jobs out of course. We already had job openings this week at a foreman's high that's pretty
segments.zh: 这确实构成了本周就业数据的一部分。本周我们已经看到职位空缺达到一个高点，这相当强劲，当然明天还有官方的非农就业数据，预计也会强劲。

segments.en: strong and of course we have the official payrolls that are tomorrow expected on the strong side too.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这些初请失业金数据目前还没有敲响任何重大警钟。

segments.en: So I don't think any major alarm bells just yet from these initial jobless claims.
segments.zh: 我现在查看数据，要找到像这样低的初请失业金人数，可能得回到很久以前，甚至早在流动性变化之前。我们在7月份也看到过同样低的读数。

segments.en: And you know I'm looking right now and I have to go back a long time possibly going back to well before the financial crisis to get an initial jobless claims as low as this. We did get another print
segments.zh: 我相信要找到类似的读数得回到20世纪60年代。我们还看到ISM服务业数据中的就业分项高于预期。ADP就业数据也好于预期。

segments.en: that was this low in July. I believe we had to go back to the 1960s to get a similar print. We also had the ISM services data with the employment component came in hotter than expected. The ADP
segments.zh: 这究竟在多大程度上预示了明天可能看到的情况？嗯，这确实表明劳动力市场处于良好状态。

segments.en: where the employment numbers came in better than expected. How much does this really drumbeat and foretell foreshadow what we could see tomorrow? Well it does suggest the labor market is in a good
segments.zh: 我认为明天的就业数据，Lisa，将关注招聘发生的广度，或者哪些领域没有招聘。例如，是否仍然依赖医疗保健行业？

segments.en: position. I think the jobs data tomorrow Lisa will be looked at for the breath of where the hiring is happening or where it's not happening. For example is it still leaning on the healthcare sector?
segments.zh: 我认为明天Lisa会关注就业数据的广度，看招聘发生在哪些领域或哪些领域没有招聘。例如，是否仍依赖医疗保健行业？
